text:
DeployBot: Started staged rollout v3.4.1 -> 10% of traffic (canary). Change window: 2026-03-23 01:00-02:00 UTC. Affected routes: generation/text, embeddings. Release notes: https://redwood/release/v3.4.1

alice: Quick note — release notes don't mention the shared-cache TTL tweak. Need to call that out.

maria: tagging @sam for region pin decision, we should watch eu-west.

sam: Seeing a small uptick in 5xxs in eu-west1: +0.8% absolute over baseline in last 5m. Recommend hold for eu-west. Suggest routing override:
```json
{"route": "eu-west1", "action": "hold"}
```

alice: Agree. Hold eu-west, continue elsewhere. :thumbsup:

sam: Ops — initiating region pin now. @DeployBot please apply routing override.

DeployBot: Override applied: region_exclude=[eu-west1]. Rollout remains 10% to other regions. Metrics stream: https://metrics/redwood/canary/1749102465

ops-bot: alert — KV cache eviction spike correlated with rollout in ap-south, latency +120ms p50. Recommend exclude ap-south as well.

maria: I'd prefer a targeted rollback to 0% in eu-west and ap-south and keep 10% elsewhere while infra patches cache behavior. Thoughts?

ben: Vote: pause globally until cache fix? I'm leaning pause to avoid more user impact.

alice: +1 pause for regions at least, keep global canary for unaffected regions.

sam: Implementing partial rollback: set percent=0 for eu-west1 and ap-south, keep 10% elsewhere. @DeployBot please apply.

DeployBot: Applied partial rollback. eu-west1=0%, ap-south=0%. Effective global rollout now 3% due to region exclusions. Monitoring for 30m. Rollout ID: r-1749102465

alice: I'll update the release notes to call out the TTL change and the region exclusions.

maria: Thanks. We'll reconvene in 10m for another quick check-in.
